{{Top|leg}}
The '''defense barrier''' [[droid shield]] was the standard for units in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] armies. It provided providing decent protection against basic harmful effects at a reasonable cost to the buyer.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' {{1st}}
